correctness.rationale: The Müller–Tomilov essential-range formula is twice the ellipse hull. Substituting r^p/s^p=e^{2v} and dividing the imaginary coordinate by 2δ gives axes 2cosh(δv)/cosh v and sinh(δv)/(δ cosh v). Both vanish at infinity for δ<1 (the limiting axes do too), so the hulls are compact; the dependence only on δ establishes conjugate symmetry. At (2,0) one must have a≥0, and with a=0 only b=0 works. For a>0 the exact support inequality follows from sinh(δv)/δ<sinh v and holds at equality in b²=4a²(1−δ²); the v² coefficient in the squared comparison excludes larger |b|. For δ≤1/2 the coordinate errors are bounded by δ² times a polynomial in v times e^{v/2}/cosh v, uniformly bounded. Matching convex combinations give the Hausdorff upper bound, and the vertical support difference at v* has positive leading coefficient v*³/(6cosh v*), giving the lower bound. For b≠0 the sign of the positive-v support derivative is the sign of v coth v−v²−4a²/b²; v coth v−v² decreases strictly from one to minus infinity by tanh(2v)<2v, including at the threshold. The b=0 and zero-normal cases are immediate. The frozen script's ellipse function and its direct comparison jointly used |p−2| instead of 2δ, scaling the normalized ordinate by an extra factor 2/p, so agreement between them did not test the stated normalization. The replacement /workspace/repairs/3/verification.py was independently constructed and run (same contents as /workspace/repro/toeplitz_normalized_range.py; finite checks passed, height 0.662743419349182). It compares correctly rescaled direct axes across conjugates and checks selected cone, maximizer and vertical excess consequences; the uploaded script was not executed. RESULT and VERIFICATION scientific notes were corrected; the universal claims rest on the analytic proof.
